items.basis: Two-clause reporting frame and pronoun; quoted options require speaker attribution. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 四个长大麻风的人说坐在这里也必死，之后他们决定怎么做？
items.mcq_question: 四个长大麻风的人说坐在这里也必死，之后他们决定怎么做？
items.basis: Reported proposition 坐在这里也必死 inside a temporal sequence; 这里 and 他们 require tracking. Long setup partly supplies passage content. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 叙利亚人以为谁要来攻击他们？
items.mcq_question: 叙利亚人以为谁要来攻击他们？
items.basis: Embedded belief proposition under 以为; paired ruler lists increase option load. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 长大麻风的人承认做得不对以后，打算怎么做？
items.mcq_question: 长大麻风的人承认做得不对以后，打算怎么做？
items.basis: Temporal clause plus embedded judgment 承认做得不对; open-ended action question. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 百姓出去掠夺叙利亚营之前，刚发生了什么事？
items.mcq_question: 百姓出去掠夺叙利亚营之前，刚发生了什么事？
items.basis: Before plus 刚 demands an immediate-predecessor event and exact event segmentation. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 百姓在城门口践踏了谁？
items.mcq_question: 百姓在城门口践踏了谁？

items.open_question: 她们约定哪一天吃另一个妇人的儿子？
items.mcq_question: 她们约定哪一天吃另一个妇人的儿子？
items.basis: 她们 and 另一个妇人 are context dependent; 今天/昨天/明天 require the temporal viewpoint of the quotation, not the participant’s day. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 两个妇人先吃了谁的孩子？
items.mcq_question: 两个妇人先吃了谁的孩子？
items.basis: 先 and 两个妇人 require distinguishing participants; correct option uses a relative clause 向王呼喊的那个妇人. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.mcq_question: 在迦特的这四个拉法的后裔，被谁杀死了？

items.open_question: 被那附着邪灵的人制服以后，谁受伤逃出了那房子？
items.mcq_question: 被那附着邪灵的人制服以后，谁受伤逃出了那房子？
items.basis: Exact MCQ received REWRITE in both saved v2 runs for naturalness and processing. Open shares the stem; open verdict is extrapolated. Earlier burden-only procedures had kept it.

items.open_question: 行邪术的人把书拿出来以后，接着做了什么？
items.mcq_question: 行邪术的人把书拿出来以后，接着做了什么？
items.basis: Temporal clause with 把 plus sequencing 接着; reasonable if sequence is the intended target. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 保罗为什么一直讲到午夜？
items.mcq_question: 保罗为什么一直讲到午夜？
items.basis: Exact MCQ received KEEP in both saved v2 runs. Open uses the same straightforward stem but was not separately evaluated in that sample.

items.open_question: 保罗离开之前，最后做的是什么？
items.mcq_question: 保罗离开之前，最后做的是什么？
items.basis: Before plus 最后 requires defining the final event; legitimate sequence target but check passage window and event boundaries. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 他们要请谁把保罗带到公会那里？
items.mcq_question: 他们要请谁把保罗带到公会那里？
items.basis: 他们 has no named referent; request + causative 把保罗带到 creates multiple actor roles. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 按保罗的话，谁有话要告诉军长？
items.mcq_question: 按保罗的话，谁有话要告诉军长？
items.basis: 按保罗的话 reporting frame; correct option 这个年轻人 relies on deixis/context. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 埋伏的人动手之前，还在等什么？
items.mcq_question: 埋伏的人动手之前，还在等什么？

items.open_question: 军长吩咐谁去预备护送的队伍？
items.mcq_question: 军长吩咐谁去预备护送的队伍？

items.open_question: 这封信是谁写的？
items.mcq_question: 这封信是谁写的？
items.basis: Direct, manageable wording; this does not establish textual validity or ease of answering. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 第二天谁回到了兵营？
items.mcq_question: 第二天谁回到了兵营？
items.basis: 第二天 is context dependent and 士兵们 may be interpreted broadly enough to include cavalry; contrast should be checked against wording in the passage. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 谁咒诅了被偷的银子？
items.mcq_question: 谁咒诅了被偷的银子？
items.basis: Content/target review only: verify whether the supplied rendering supports “cursed the silver”. Earlier wording-only trials kept it; do not treat the old Priority label as an established wording defect.

items.mcq_question: 母亲说谁要用这银子制作雕像？

items.open_question: 他们请谁为他们求问这趟行程？
items.mcq_question: 他们请谁为他们求问这趟行程？
items.basis: 他们…为他们 leaves both groups implicit; 求问这趟行程 is awkwardly compressed. Request plus consultation introduces multiple roles. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 那少年利未人为什么离开伯利恒？

items.open_question: 来士的人为什么富足？
items.mcq_question: 来士的人为什么富足？
items.basis: Wording was kept by all recent procedures. The remaining question is content: whether the passage supports the requested causal relation. This forecast does not establish that it fails.

items.open_question: 米迦为什么认为耶和华必向他施恩？
items.mcq_question: 米迦为什么认为耶和华必向他施恩？

items.open_question: 谁进去拿走了雕像、以弗得、家用神像和熔铸的偶像？
items.mcq_question: 谁进去拿走了雕像、以弗得、家用神像和熔铸的偶像？
items.basis: Four-object list with specialized terms 以弗得/熔铸的偶像. Stem structure is manageable; lexical/list load is high. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 那些神像最先发生了什么事？
items.mcq_question: 那些神像最先发生了什么事？
items.basis: 那些神像最先发生了什么事 is unnatural topic wording; 最先 has no explicit starting point. Existing window override also matters. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 是什么使但人转过身来？
items.mcq_question: 是什么使但人转过身来？
items.basis: Correct option has long place-modified subject; near-causal distractor 被…追上 may invite competing causal explanations. Check specificity of evidence. This is provisional, not an observed v2 admission decision.

items.open_question: 为什么没有人搭救来士的人？
items.mcq_question: 为什么没有人搭救来士的人？
